source_positions.quote: Because of this, we must account for the energy used to make these changes.
Because we have material entering and leaving the CV, we can imagine that this material can enter or leave with a different pressure and density as it interacts with our fixed CV.
Alternatively, one can envision the material coming in at a higher pressure or density and wanting to push our imaginary CV outward, but since we fixed our CV, it cannot.
